mapper.select: SELECT admin_id, admin_login_id, admin_name, admin_email, admin_phone, admin_role, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM admin
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin (admin_login_id, admin_password, admin_name, admin_email, admin_phone, admin_role, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{adminLoginId}, #{adminPassword}, #{adminName}, #{adminEmail}, #{adminPhone}, #{adminRole}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE admin SET admin_login_id = #{adminLoginId}, admin_name = #{adminName}, admin_email = #{adminEmail}, admin_phone = #{adminPhone}, admin_role = #{adminRole}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
UPDATE admin SET admin_password = #{adminPassword}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
